# feedMyPixel

> Ben Chidgey - contract full-stack engineer trading as feedMyPixel Ltd. Twenty years building for
> the Guardian, the BBC and UK government. Available worldwide and remote.

## About

Ben Chidgey has worked as a contract engineer since 2011, mostly on public-facing services with a
strong accessibility and progressive-enhancement bias. Recent work is SvelteKit, TypeScript, Node and
AWS. Clients include the Guardian, the BBC, DEFRA, the Ministry of Justice, HMRC, HM Passport Office,
Marks & Spencer, Wayfair, Pret A Manger and Deutsche Telekom.

## Products

- [status](https://feedmypixel.com/status): an emoji and your status. Break the ice and spark a
  conversation. React, reply and natter. A SvelteKit and Svelte 5 web app with a Fastify and
  PostgreSQL api. The iPhone and Android apps are Capacitor shells around the live site. No ads and
  no tracking. Live at [status.me](https://status.me), on the App Store and on Google Play.
- [Pipes](https://feedmypixel.com/pipes): CI/CD pipeline monitoring as a browser extension.
  Watches GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD and goes loud the moment a default branch breaks. Fully
  client-side - no server, no tracking. Published on the Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons.
  [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/feedmypixel/pipes).
